skill.name: organize-google-contacts
skill.description: Manage Google Contacts through Rarefriend MCP with search, notes, tags, bulk import, and Google sync support.
skill.summary: Search, update, tag, and enrich Google Contacts through Rarefriend relationship memory.
skill.author: Whitefield-Labs

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, tool names, and client configuration paths. I confirmed the user-run MCP setup command because it installs and launches a community npm package through npx. Semantic review also found privacy, credential-handling, and destructive-operation risks for Google Contacts data.

remediation.suggestion: Publish a pinned version and integrity guidance for @rarefriend-ai/mcp. Ask before running or configuring npx.

remediation.issue: Sensitive contact data access through Rarefriend
remediation.suggestion: Show a consent step explaining Rarefriend, Google Contacts scope, and note storage before connecting.
Require confirmation before delete, bulk import, bulk tagging, tag renames, and large updates.

remediation.issue: OAuth client secrets in local configuration
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to store secrets only in private local configs or secret managers. Warn against sharing setup logs.

semantic_findings.title: Sensitive Contact Data Routed Through Third-Party Service
semantic_findings.description: The skill directs users to connect Google Contacts to Rarefriend and manage relationship notes through that service. This creates privacy risk for contact PII and relationship metadata.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The skill explicitly describes Rarefriend as the layer over Google Contacts and provides a Google Contacts connection workflow. The data flow is expected but privacy-sensitive.

semantic_findings.title: Destructive and Bulk Contact Changes Need Confirmation
semantic_findings.description: The skill exposes update, delete, bulk create, rename tag, and bulk tagging workflows. These actions can modify or remove many contact records.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The quick reference and workflows list delete, update, bulk create, tag rename, and bulk tag operations. Only update is paired with an explicit confirmation instruction.

semantic_findings.title: OAuth Client Secrets in Local MCP Configuration
semantic_findings.description: The setup guide tells users to place Rarefriend client secrets in MCP command flags or local client configuration. These secrets can leak through shared configs or logs.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation directly shows the client ID and client secret being supplied to MCP setup. This is a common pattern, but it requires careful local secret handling.

content.value_statement: Google Contacts often lack context from meetings, notes, and relationship history. This skill uses Rarefriend MCP to search, tag, update, and enrich contacts from an AI assistant.
actual_capabilities: Detect Rarefriend MCP connection status and Google Contacts sync status.
Search contacts by name, company, role, email, source, or tag.
Create, update, and bulk import contacts in batches of 50.
Create, edit, pin, list, and search relationship notes.
Add, remove, rename, and apply tags across contact groups.
Generate a Google Contacts connection link and check sync progress.
limitations: Requires Rarefriend MCP credentials and a connected Google Contacts integration.
Uses Rarefriend as the contact service, not direct Google Contacts API access.
Bulk create calls are limited to 50 contacts at a time.
Setup requires MCP installation or manual client configuration.

use_cases.title: Prepare for sales outreach
use_cases.description: Find contacts by company, review notes, and tag people for follow-up lists.

use_cases.title: Manage an investor network
use_cases.description: Search investors, add meeting notes, and group contacts by firm or stage.

use_cases.title: Track recruiting relationships
use_cases.description: Record candidate conversations, find people by role, and keep contact sources clear.

prompt_templates.title: Find a contact
prompt_templates.prompt: Find everyone I know at [company]. Show names, roles, emails, and source labels.

prompt_templates.title: Record a meeting note
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a note for [name] summarizing this meeting: [summary]. Pin it if it includes a clear follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Clean contact tags
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for contacts at [companies]. Tag matching contacts as [tag]. Ask before applying tags to more than 10 people.

prompt_templates.title: Import a contact list
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an import for this contact list: [contacts]. Split it into batches of 50 and ask before creating records.

output_examples.input: Find everyone I know at Stripe.
output_examples.output: Found matching contacts with names, roles, emails, and source labels. The assistant highlights which records came from Google Contacts.

output_examples.input: Add a note from my call with Priya about the renewal discussion.
output_examples.output: The assistant finds the contact, confirms the person, and saves a dated relationship note with the provided summary.

output_examples.input: Tag everyone at Sequoia as investor.
output_examples.output: The assistant searches matching contacts, shows the proposed list, and asks for confirmation before applying the tag.

best_practices: Confirm contact identity before updating or deleting records.
Mention whether results came from Google Contacts, manual entries, or another source.
Keep notes factual and avoid sensitive details unless the user requests them.
anti_patterns: Do not bulk tag or import ambiguous contacts without confirmation.
Do not paste OAuth secrets or connection links into shared channels.
Do not use this skill for calendar scheduling tasks.

faq.question: Does this skill require Rarefriend?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires Rarefriend MCP credentials and a connected Rarefriend account.

faq.question: Can it connect Google Contacts?
faq.answer: Yes. It can request a Google Contacts connection link through Rarefriend.

faq.question: Can it search by company or tag?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports company, role, email, source, tag, and exact-match searches.

faq.question: Can it import many contacts?
faq.answer: Yes. It can bulk import contacts in batches of 50 records.

faq.question: Can it delete contacts or notes?
faq.answer: The referenced tools include delete operations. Users should confirm destructive actions before they run.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
